Migrated the project to App Router.

Created [app/layout.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/layout.tsx), [app/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/page.tsx), and [app/about/page.tsx](/vercel/sandbox/app/about/page.tsx). Removed the old `pages` files, moved `Head` metadata to App Router metadata exports, and changed internal links to `next/link`.

Verified with:

```bash
npm run build
```

Also checked `GET /` and `GET /about` return `200`. Dev server is running at `http://localhost:3000`.

Note: `package.json` and `package-lock.json` already had pre-existing git status before this work; I left them alone.
